content.user_title: Manage Gmail with Google Workspace CLI
content.value_statement: Managing Gmail through API commands requires accurate resource names and parameters. This skill guides Claude and Codex through supported Gmail CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides Gmail API calls through the gws command-line interface.
Identifies resources for drafts, history, labels, messages, settings, and threads.
Directs users to helper workflows for sending, reading, replying, forwarding, triaging, and watching email.
Explains how to inspect method schemas before building parameters.
Supports profile retrieval and push notification watch management.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and an authenticated Google Workspace account.
Depends on the separate gws-shared skill for authentication and security guidance.
Detailed helper workflows require their referenced sibling skills.
Actual Gmail access remains limited by the authenticated account permissions.

use_cases.title: Triage an inbox
use_cases.description: Summarize unread messages by sender, subject, and date before choosing what needs attention.

use_cases.title: Automate support replies
use_cases.description: Inspect message threads and prepare correctly threaded replies for customer conversations.

use_cases.title: Monitor mailbox activity
use_cases.description: Configure Gmail watch operations and process new message notifications for an internal workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Check my inbox
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my unread Gmail messages with sender, subject, and date. Do not change any messages.

prompt_templates.title: Read a message
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the latest message from [sender], then show its body and key headers without modifying it.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a concise reply to message [message ID]. Preserve threading and ask for confirmation before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Configure mailbox monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the Gmail watch schema, propose required parameters for [topic], and configure monitoring only after approval.

output_examples.input: Prepare a reply confirming Friday at 10:00.
output_examples.output: Draft prepared: Friday at 10:00 works for me. I will wait for your approval before sending.

output_examples.input: Which Gmail resources can this skill manage?
output_examples.output: It covers profiles, drafts, history, labels, messages, settings, threads, and mailbox notification watches.

best_practices: Inspect the method schema before every unfamiliar Gmail API call.
Confirm recipients, subject, and message content before sending or forwarding email.
Use the narrowest account permissions that support the requested workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not send, reply, or forward messages without explicit user approval.
Do not guess resource parameters when schema inspection is available.
Do not expose message bodies, headers, or account data beyond the requested scope.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the gws CLI, authenticate a Google Workspace account, and make the shared Gmail skills available.

faq.question: Can it send email?
faq.answer: Yes. The referenced send helper supports email delivery, subject to account permissions and user approval.

faq.question: Can it read and summarize messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve message bodies or headers and support unread inbox summaries.

faq.question: Does it support replies and forwarding?
faq.answer: Yes. Referenced helpers support threaded replies, reply-all actions, and forwarding to new recipients.

faq.question: Can it monitor new email?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes Gmail watch operations and a helper that streams new messages as NDJSON.

faq.question: How are command parameters determined?
faq.answer: The skill directs the agent to inspect each method with gws schema before building parameters and request bodies.
